digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 and batch runner usage aggregation
propositions: Pass-1 functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) discard per-call usage attached by runner, blocking token totals and per-criterion request counts in batch outputs and coverage metrics

Three pass functions and run_focused_finder must be refactored to thread usage dicts through their return values as coordinated API changes with all external callers (eval_solver, criterion_preview, fidelity_spot_eval, sizing, production_batch_runner) updated atomically

Multi-criterion chunks must divide token fields equally across covered criteria while counting llm_calls in full per criterion; ladder retries each contribute a call record; checkpoint-served chunks and raising attempts contribute no usage
BatchRunResult.outputs and sidecar payload must expose aggregated usage as per_call records (with criteria lists) and per_criterion maps, integrated into coverage.metrics and coverage.usage
run_focused_finder usage must sum all internal run_bin recursive calls; checkpoint fast-path contributes zero; missing _usage on any call degrades gracefully to zero
